title: Xbox CEO Teases The Elder Scrolls 6 Title and Scale Amidst Protests
description: Recent reports indicate the Xbox CEO discussed The Elder Scrolls 6's title and story while union protests occurred nearby.

sources.title: Xbox CEO teases The Elder Scrolls 6's title and praises the game's scale and story
Xbox CEO praises Elder Scrolls 6 as protesters unveil giant inflatable rat
'One flag for each laid off dev:' Union workers stage unmissable protest for Xbox boss Asha Sharma

sections.heading: Xbox CEO Comments on Game Features
paragraphs: According to IMDb, the Xbox CEO teased the title of The Elder Scrolls 6. The source also notes that the executive praised the game's scale and story.

sections.heading: Protests Unfold During Event
paragraphs: Yahoo Tech reports that the Xbox CEO praised The Elder Scrolls 6 while protesters unveiled a giant inflatable rat.

sections.heading: Union Workers Demonstrate
paragraphs: Game Developer states that union workers staged an unmissable protest for Xbox boss Asha Sharma. The report adds that the demonstration featured one flag for each laid-off developer.

faq.q: What did the Xbox CEO say about The Elder Scrolls 6?
faq.a: According to IMDb, the CEO teased the game's title and praised its scale and story.

faq.q: Did any protests occur related to the event?
faq.a: Yes, Yahoo Tech reports that protesters unveiled a giant inflatable rat while the CEO spoke.

faq.q: Who was the target of the union protest mentioned by Game Developer?
faq.a: Game Developer reports that the protest was staged for Xbox boss Asha Sharma.
